content:
The City of Laredo's free bulky waste collection reaches District VI on Thursday, Nov. 19, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Items must be set out before 6 a.m., accessible from the street and at least 10 feet away from large objects such as cars, fences, mailboxes, power lines and trees. Items will not be collected from private property, according to the report.

Accepted items include bicycles, box springs, carpeting, furniture, household appliances, large toys, mattresses and plastic swimming pools. Not accepted are televisions and other electronic waste, batteries, car parts, items with combustion engines, items with a title, paints and other liquids, rocks, concrete, asphalt, gravel and dirt, and hazardous waste such as chemicals and fluorescent bulbs, according to the report.

Only active residential accounts are eligible for the service, which the city offers twice a year. The fall round began Sept. 14 in District I, and the remaining dates are District VII on Friday, Dec. 4, and District VIII on Wednesday, Dec. 16. The previous round ran April 13 through July 22, according to the report.

Residents who miss their collection date can schedule a pickup appointment. Those who pay City of Laredo garbage fees can get two pickups a year at no cost by calling in advance and requesting a work order, with up to four items per pickup. Extra items cost $15 for the first, $10 for the second and $5 for each additional item. More information is available at laredosolidwaste.com, by calling 3-1-1 or at 956-796-1098, according to the report.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 17, 2026.

Webb Watch 956
excerpt: District VI residents can set out furniture, mattresses, appliances and more before 6 a.m. Thursday, Nov. 19, as the City of Laredo's free fall bulky waste collection continues.
title: Free Bulky Trash Pickup Comes to District VI on Thursday
